notes.title: Road to Alpha
notes.notes:
Hello!

A lot of progress has been made since the opening of this Steam page. The release of an alpha demo version is on the horizon. The game now has everything needed to be playable in its alpha version.

I am currently focusing on debugging this version. I am not adding any new features; I am working hard to make it as stable as possible.

I will soon post a video showcasing the gameplay of the game, which you will be able to find in the alpha demo.

Thank you and see you soon!
